answer: Random mutual audit blocks fakes. Each epoch a beacon picks agents for review: an auditor checks a peer's trades in a whisper. A genuine trader deals with many partners, like streams reaching an oasis. A sybil farm trades only with itself, in a dune of self-dealing. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 50 = 50,000 units at slash risk; one honest agent pays 50 and keeps undiluted rewards. A rented history fails: its lender is slashed too.
